title: Pivot Appointment Types by Provider
prompt: The telehealth platform stores appointment data in long format: each row in `appointment_counts` records one provider, one appointment type, and a count. Write a query that pivots this data into wide format with one row per provider. For each provider, create three columns: `initial_consult_count` (SUM of counts where appointment_type = 'initial_consult'), `follow_up_count` (SUM of counts where appointment_type = 'follow_up'), and `urgent_care_count` (SUM of counts where appointment_type = 'urgent_care'). If a provider has no appointments of a certain type, display 0 instead of NULL. Join to the `providers` table to include `provider_name` in the output. Return columns: provider_id, provider_name, initial_consult_count, follow_up_count, urgent_care_count. Order the result by provider_id ascending.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE providers (provider_id INT PRIMARY KEY, provider_name VARCHAR(100)); CREATE TABLE appointment_counts (provider_id INT, appointment_type VARCHAR(50), count_value INT);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO providers (provider_id, provider_name) VALUES (101, 'Dr. Alice Chen'), (102, 'Dr. Bob Martinez'), (103, 'Dr. Carol Singh'); INSERT INTO appointment_counts (provider_id, appointment_type, count_value) VALUES (101, 'initial_consult', 5), (101, 'follow_up', 12), (101, 'urgent_care', 3), (102, 'initial_consult', 8), (102, 'follow_up', 6), (103, 'urgent_care', 2), (103, 'urgent_care', 1);

composite_moves: join providers and appointment_counts on provider_id
pivot appointment_type into columns using SUM(CASE WHEN ...) with COALESCE for zero-fill

hints: You need to transform rows into columns by pivoting the appointment_type field.
Use COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN appointment_type = 'X' THEN count_value END), 0) AS x_count for each appointment type.
Join providers to appointment_counts, GROUP BY provider_id and provider_name, then create three pivoted columns with SUM(CASE WHEN ...) wrapped in COALESCE.
answer_key: SELECT p.provider_id, p.provider_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ac.appointment_type = 'initial_consult' THEN ac.count_value END), 0) AS initial_consult_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ac.appointment_type = 'follow_up' THEN ac.count_value END), 0) AS follow_up_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ac.appointment_type = 'urgent_care' THEN ac.count_value END), 0) AS urgent_care_count FROM providers p LEFT JOIN appointment_counts ac ON p.provider_id = ac.provider_id GROUP BY p.provider_id, p.provider_name ORDER BY p.provider_id;

_meta.scenario: a telehealth platform tracking appointment scheduling and no-shows
